role: independent Apple, Google Play and Japan policy critic
method: Verified that policy-release gates map to the dated source register and distinguish platform policy, regulator guidance, user reviews and inference.
Attempted rejection for comp gacha, undisclosed randomized items, expiring paid currency, missing restore/deletion, disruptive ads, misleading value and unsupported legal/store-approval conclusions.

findings.finding: Submission-time Apple/Google refresh and Japanese specialist review remain NOT_STARTED by design.
findings.whyNotBlockingStep1: Step 1 is a design seal, not a release approval; the gate is explicitly fail-closed and cannot be converted into a legal conclusion or store approval claim.
findings.owner: Release owner before submission and after material provider/catalog change
findings.blockingCondition: Blocks release PASS, not Step 1 or Step 2 start.
